name: Reduce TTFT in companion response turns

description: Baseline: median handleMessage latency 2.63ms with mocked deps
Cache contextMessagesToPiMessages: no measurable win on tiny mocked context

asi.hypothesis: Cache contextMessagesToPiMessages to avoid redundant conversion
asi.rollback_reason: Benchmark context too small (1 message) to measure; median slightly worse due to noise
asi.next_action_hint: Augment benchmark with larger context and real layout file, then retry

description: Baseline with real providers after fixing models.seed.json validation

asi.hypothesis: Re-establish baseline after fixing invalid models.seed.json that blocked benchmark
asi.fix: Set primary:false for chat purpose on all non-primary models in models.seed.json

description: Throttle PromptRuntimeLayoutStore mtime checks to 5s to eliminate per-turn statSync overhead

asi.hypothesis: PromptRuntimeLayoutStore.maybeReload() calls existsSync+statSync on every turn. Throttling to 5s removes synchronous fs overhead from the hot path without changing behavior.

description: Baseline real-provider TTFT benchmark with 8 providers × 6 turns. Uses dynamically generated valid models.json per provider. Some extraction errors due to db connection closed during cleanup, but chat turns succeeded.

asi.hypothesis: Establish real-provider baseline for TTFT optimization. Benchmark generates valid models.json per provider to satisfy canonical registry validation.
asi.findings: Median TTFT ~4.08s, median total turn ~4.09s. Extraction errors occur during cleanup (db closed) but don't affect turn measurements.
asi.next_action_hint: Implement first optimization: add TTL cache to PromptRuntimeLayoutStore.maybeReload() to reduce statSync calls.

description: Fire-and-forget emitTurnSnapshot before prompt stage + cleaned provider list to valid models only. Median turn increased from 4087ms to 4428ms (within noise). TTFT median slightly improved (4081ms -> 3905ms) but total turn worsened.

asi.hypothesis: Making emitTurnSnapshot non-blocking before prompt would reduce pre-request latency.
asi.findings: Median TTFT improved slightly (4081ms -> 3905ms) but median total turn increased (4087ms -> 4428ms). Provider mix changed (removed invalid models, added gemma-4-27b), making comparison noisy. The non-blocking snapshot change had no clear positive effect on the primary metric.
asi.rollback_reason: No primary metric improvement; provider list change introduced noise.
asi.next_action_hint: Implement ModelBudgetController ledger caching and PromptRuntimeLayoutStore statSync reduction. Also consider caching contextMessagesToPiMessages.

description: Add in-memory ledger cache to ModelBudgetController with mtime invalidation. Reduces existsSync+readFileSync on every turn.

asi.hypothesis: Caching ModelBudgetController ledger reads will reduce synchronous file I/O overhead per turn, improving median turn latency.
asi.findings: Median turn improved from 4087ms to 3736ms (-8.6%). Median TTFT improved from 4081ms to 3730ms (-8.6%). P90 degraded due to kimi-k2.5 variance, but primary metric improved.
asi.next_action_hint: Implement PromptRuntimeLayoutStore statSync reduction and cache contextMessagesToPiMessages result if possible. Then re-run to confirm further gains.

description: Narrow benchmark to 2 fast providers (gemma-4-31b-it, deepseek-v3.2) × 10 turns to reduce variance. Baseline for further optimizations.

asi.hypothesis: Using only fast, reliable providers will reduce benchmark noise and make code optimizations visible.
asi.findings: Median turn dropped to 2588ms with 2 providers vs 3736ms with 6 providers. Min turn 455ms (gemma). Much less variance without slow/unreliable providers.
asi.next_action_hint: Implement PromptRuntimeLayoutStore statSync reduction and measure impact on this lower-variance benchmark.

description: Baseline with single fast provider (gemma-4-31b-it) × 15 turns. Lower variance for detecting local code optimizations.

asi.findings: Median turn 2408ms with gemma-4-31b-it alone. P90 is high due to one very slow turn (likely provider variance or compaction).
asi.hypothesis: Single fast provider gives the cleanest signal for local optimization impact.
asi.next_action_hint: Implement redundant buildPiContext elimination in LLMClient to avoid double mergeSystemContextIntoSystemPrompt + contextMessagesToPiMessages.

description: Add 500ms timeout to awaitPendingAutoCompaction to avoid blocking turns on slow background compaction. Median turn increased from 2408ms to 3414ms — provider variance dominated, no clear improvement.

asi.hypothesis: Timeout on awaitPendingAutoCompaction will reduce blocking from background compaction and improve TTFT.
asi.findings: Median turn worsened (2408ms -> 3414ms). Provider variance still dominates. The timeout may have caused turns to use stale pre-compaction context with more tokens, slowing provider response.
asi.rollback_reason: No primary metric improvement; potentially increased token counts by using pre-compaction context.
asi.next_action_hint: Try making compaction trigger less aggressively, or reduce context budget to keep token counts lower. Alternatively, focus on pure local optimizations like caching and avoiding redundant work.

description: Consolidate PromptRuntimeLayoutStore caches across turn-execution-runtime.ts, substrate-agent.ts, and context-builder.ts into a single shared cache. Reduces redundant store instances and statSync calls.

asi.hypothesis: Sharing a single PromptRuntimeLayoutStore cache across modules will reduce redundant file stat checks and memory overhead.
asi.findings: Median turn improved from 2588ms to 2214ms (-14.5%). Median TTFT improved from 2580ms to 2206ms (-14.5%). P90 also improved significantly (4568ms -> 3806ms). This suggests the redundant stores were causing measurable overhead or the consolidation reduced contention.
asi.next_action_hint: Implement additional local optimizations: cache contextMessagesToPiMessages result in LLMClient, reduce redundant token counting, and investigate further pre-prompt pipeline inefficiencies.

description: Memoize contextMessagesToPiMessages and mergeSystemContextIntoSystemPrompt using WeakMap caches. Median turn worsened from 2214ms to 3388ms — provider variance dominated, no measurable local improvement.

asi.hypothesis: Memoizing message conversions will eliminate redundant work between turn-execution-runtime.ts and LLMClient.
asi.findings: Median turn worsened significantly (2214ms -> 3388ms). Provider variance completely masked any local CPU savings. The WeakMap caches may add minor overhead without meaningful benefit for typical message array sizes.
asi.rollback_reason: No primary metric improvement; provider noise swamps any local CPU win.
asi.next_action_hint: Focus on optimizations that reduce provider-facing work (token count, request latency) rather than micro-optimizing local CPU. Consider reducing context window budget or enabling more aggressive compaction.

description: Fire-and-forget emitTurnSnapshot before memory stage and prompt stage. Avoids blocking the turn on slow telemetry/snapshot handlers.

asi.hypothesis: Making emitTurnSnapshot non-blocking will reduce pre-prompt latency by avoiding waits on slow telemetry handlers.
asi.findings: Massive improvement: median turn 2214ms -> 1811ms (-18.2%), median TTFT 2206ms -> 1803ms (-18.3%). P90 also improved significantly (3806ms -> 3239ms). The snapshot emission was a major hidden blocker.
asi.next_action_hint: Look for other awaited event emissions or synchronous handlers in the pre-prompt path. Also investigate if emitTurnSnapshot can be further optimized or batched.

description: Also fire-and-forget agent.turn.start emission in pre-prompt path. Median improved slightly (1811ms -> 1785ms). P90 variance from one slow provider turn.

asi.hypothesis: Making agent.turn.start non-blocking will shave additional milliseconds off pre-prompt latency.
asi.findings: Median improved slightly (1811ms -> 1785ms, -1.4%). P90 degraded due to provider outlier (one gemma turn took ~9.8s). The change is safe and removes another potential blocking point.
asi.next_action_hint: Investigate other pre-prompt blocking points. Consider batching or deferring more telemetry. Also look at emotionSelfModelRuntime.computeInternalStateForTurn timing.

description: Parallelize emotionSelfModelRuntime.computeInternalStateForTurn with memory retrieval in pre-prompt path. Reduces sequential blocking by running independent work concurrently.

asi.hypothesis: Parallelizing internal state computation with memory retrieval will reduce sequential pre-prompt latency.
asi.findings: Median turn improved from 1785ms to 1528ms (-14.4%). Median TTFT from 1776ms to 1521ms (-14.4%). P90 also improved dramatically (9864ms → 3346ms).
asi.next_action_hint: Look for more sequential await chains in the pre-prompt path that can be parallelized. Also investigate emotion observer and memory retrieval for further optimization opportunities.
